map.年租金 = 月租金 × 12；净收益 = 年租金 − 年度支出（物业、维修、空置: Annual rent = monthly rent × 12; net income = annual rent − annual expenses (property, maintenance, vacancy and management fees); rental yield = net income ÷ property total price × 100% (gross yield uses annual rent ÷ total price); payback years = 1 ÷ yield; in international comparison, yield below 3% is low, 4%–6% is reasonable, above 6% is good, and a rising vacancy rate significantly lowers the actual return.

map.年毛租金 = 月租金 × 12；空置损失 = 月租金 × 年空置月数；有效租金: Annual gross rent = monthly rent × 12; vacancy loss = monthly rent × vacancy months; effective rent = gross rent − vacancy loss; annual net income = effective rent − annual holding costs (excluding vacancy loss to avoid double counting); gross yield = annual gross rent ÷ price × 100%; net yield = annual net income ÷ price × 100%; static payback = price ÷ annual net income (not applicable when net income ≤0).

map.📚 深度解析：毛/净租金回报与静态回本: 📚 Deep Dive: Gross/Net Rental Yield and Static Payback
map.买房出租前同时看毛回报率与净回报率：毛回报只按年租金÷总价，净回报再扣空置损失与: Before buying to rent, look at both gross and net yield: gross uses annual rent ÷ price; net also deducts vacancy loss and holding costs.
map.用年空置月数显式折算空置损失，避免既在空置月数里扣一次、又在持有成本里重复扣一次: Vacancy months explicitly convert to vacancy loss, avoiding a deduction in both vacancy months and holding costs.
map.把回本周期当作静态估算，并明确未包含融资利息、资金时间价值、租金增长、税费变化与: Treat payback as a static estimate, explicitly excluding financing interest, time value of money, rent growth, tax changes and sale price.
map.年毛租金 = 4 500×12 = 54 000 元；空置损失 = 4 500×: Annual gross rent = 4,500×12 = 54,000 CNY; vacancy loss = 4,500×1 = 4,500 CNY; effective rent = 49,500 CNY; annual holding costs 15,000 CNY → net income = 34,500 CNY. Gross yield = 54,000 ÷ 1,200,000 = 4.50%; net yield = 34,500 ÷ 1,200,000 = 2.875% ≈ 2.88%; static payback = 1,200,000 ÷ 34,500 ≈ 34.8 years. With three vacancy months, net income falls to 25,500 CNY and net yield to 2.13%.
map.空置损失会不会和持有成本重复扣？: Is vacancy loss deducted twice with holding costs?
map.不会。年持有成本明确标注「不含空置损失」，空置损失由空置月数单独折算；若把预估空: No. Annual holding costs explicitly exclude vacancy loss, and vacancy loss is calculated separately from vacancy months; if you also put estimated vacancy loss into holding costs, it is deducted twice.
map.为什么回本周期不是精确投资结论？: Why is payback not a precise investment conclusion?
map.它是静态估算：假设月租全年不变、空置按 12 个月折算，且不考虑融资利息、资金时: It is static: rent is assumed unchanged all year, vacancy is based on 12 months, and financing interest, time value, rent growth, tax changes and sale price are excluded. Build a separate cash-flow model for loans and capital gains.
